# Start Your Recovery

> A comprehensive substance abuse recovery platform offering treatment locators, educational resources, support group information, and personalized recovery planning tools.

Start Your Recovery provides free access to 250+ inpatient centers, 11,000+ outpatient options, and extensive educational content on addiction recognition, treatment types, medication-assisted therapy, and overdose prevention. The site accepts major insurance providers including Medicaid, Medicare, Blue Cross Blue Shield, Cigna, Anthem, and UnitedHealthcare, making recovery resources accessible to diverse populations.

## Core Resources

- [Start Your Recovery: Substance Abuse Resources & Support](https://startyourrecovery.org): Homepage for substance abuse recovery resources and support networks.
- [Find Drug & Alcohol Treatment Near You (250+ Free Centers)](https://startyourrecovery.org/treatment): Main treatment locator with 250+ free centers and 11,000+ outpatient options.
- [Hear Stories | Start Your Recovery](https://startyourrecovery.org/hear-stories): Recovery stories and personal narratives from individuals in addiction recovery.

## Understanding Addiction & Treatment

- [Recognize the Signs of a Drug or Alcohol Problem](https://startyourrecovery.org/signs): Guide to recognizing addiction signs and warning indicators of substance abuse.
- [What is Rehab? Types, Costs, & Whether Rehab is Right for You](https://startyourrecovery.org/treatment/rehab-centers): Comprehensive guide defining rehab types, costs, and treatment program considerations.
- [Make Your Addiction Treatment and Recovery Plan](https://startyourrecovery.org/treatment/make-a-recovery-plan): Guide to creating personalized addiction recovery plans and setting recovery goals.

## Treatment Options & Support

- [Medication-Assisted Treatment: Opioid and Alcohol Use Disorders](https://startyourrecovery.org/treatment/medications): Guide to MAT programs including buprenorphine, methadone, and naltrexone options.
- [Addiction Counseling for Alcohol and Drug Abuse](https://startyourrecovery.org/treatment/counseling): Guide to addiction counseling options and selecting mental health professionals.
- [Support Groups for Alcohol and Drug Abuse](https://startyourrecovery.org/treatment/support-groups): Overview of support groups including AA, NA, SMART Recovery, and Cocaine Anonymous.
- [Opioid Overdose Prevention: Get Naloxone](https://startyourrecovery.org/treatment/preventing-responding-to-an-opioid-overdose): Educational guide on naloxone access and opioid overdose prevention strategies.
